description: Source code for the gamemap class in the Wesnoth game, handling map data, terrain, locations, and map operations.

classes.name: gamemap::location
classes.description: Represents a coordinate location on the map with methods for parsing directions, arithmetic, and serialization.

classes.name: gamemap
classes.description: Represents the game map, including terrain data, locations, and map operations such as reading, writing, overlaying, and terrain queries.

methods.name: underlying_terrain
methods.description: Returns the string representation of terrain.

methods.name: is_village
methods.description: Checks if terrain or location is a village.

methods.name: gives_healing
methods.description: Checks if terrain or location provides healing.

methods.name: is_castle
methods.description: Checks if terrain is a castle.

methods.name: is_keep
methods.description: Checks if terrain is a keep.

methods.name: parse_direction
methods.description: Parses a string into a direction enum.

methods.name: location::location
methods.description: Constructs a location from config data.

methods.name: get_direction
methods.description: Returns a location offset based on direction.

methods.name: gamemap::gamemap
methods.description: Constructs a map from config and data string.

methods.name: overlay
methods.description: Overlays another map onto this map with rules.

methods.name: set_starting_position
methods.description: Sets starting position for a side.

methods.name: is_starting_position
methods.description: Checks if location is a starting position.

methods.name: remove_from_border_cache
methods.description: Removes a location from border cache.
